_comment: Ollama config for desktop (AMD-ROCm). Copy to config.json and adjust.
_firewall_note: Ensure Windows inbound firewall rule allows TCP 11434 for LAN access from server.
_env_note: Also set OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 as environment variable for reliability.
_context_note: Windows app overrides OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH with its VRAM-based default (env shows :0). Use the derived model: run desktop/scripts/startup.ps1 to create deepseek-r1-16k (Modelfile num_ctx 16384) and point OpenCode at that name. On Linux/Docker, OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH is honored.
